# Introduction
The {{"template":"referral","description":"an unobtainable item","plural":false,"of":"self"}} is an unobtainable item introduced in {{"template":"referral","of":"to_base:mod_version / to_sky_and_stars:0.0.2"}}. It was the first item implemented in {{"of":"to_base:mod / to_base:to_sky_and_stars"}} for testing purposes.

This item may sometimes be given debug uses during development, such as detonating a nuclear explosion during development of {{"of":"to_base:mod_version / to_sky_and_stars:0.1.0","short":true}}.
